test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
There are twelve persons sitting in a circle do not face each other keeping equal distance between neighbouring members.

L and H are sitting opposite to each other while G and I are sitting opposite to each other.

L is sitting to the immediate right side of I.

A is sitting immediately next to and in-between H and C.

On the basis of the above information select the correct statement from among those given in the options.

options.text: A is 5th person to the left of I.
I is 4th person to the right of C.
G is sitting to immediate left of H.
C and L are sitting beside each other.

solution: Given: 1) L and H are sitting opposite to each other while G and I are sitting opposite to each other. 2) L is sitting to the immediate right side of I [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6159df21e48507e24b7fccd7cbfcc58436af83266ec5537fcf21375b04d9c4ad.png] 3) A is sitting immediately next to and in between H and C.
